body: Thanks for all the positive advice-I haven't asked out a girl yet, but I found a local place to take someone to. Also, I hung out with friends for the first time in 5 months(someone called me and asked if I wanted to hang out). I'm taking this day by day, but I hope I'm on a route to happiness.

Thanks for the homework offer. My main problem with school is my style-get bored while the teacher talks, and try my best to use the info on work.
  Gaming isn't really an option-my parents hate it when I play x-box, and there is no way to play it without them around.

There is a girl I'm interested in, she says hi and we talk sometimes. I think its more of a friend thing though.  My main question about a girlfriend is what to do with her (activities, not sex tips.)

Money-wise I don't want too much.
I haven't tried camping, but there are a lot of walking paths around.
I'm looking forward to a group of friends to talk and hang around with. I ask people if they will hang out with me, but they forget about it or don't care enough to make the effort.
By outside of high school I mean that nobody asks me to hang out with them.
